featured_reviews.name: _1_Vaijnath_ Goler वैजनाथ गोलेर
featured_reviews.review_text:
Mathura Sweet Mart: A Culinary Delight
Mathura Sweet Mart is a haven for those with a sweet tooth. This vibrant store is a treasure trove of traditional Indian sweets, each one a masterpiece of taste and texture. From the delicate rasgulla soaked in syrup to the rich and nutty kaju katli, every sweet is a testament to the artistry of Indian confectionery.
The shop's ambiance is warm and inviting, with shelves lined with colorful boxes and jars of sweets. The aroma of cardamom, saffron, and other spices fills the air, tantalizing the senses. Whether you're looking for a special treat for a festive occasion or simply craving a sweet indulgence, Indian Sweet Mart has something to offer.
Beyond the traditional sweets, the mart often features seasonal specialties like the delectable besan laddoo during Diwali or the refreshing sandesh during Holi. The friendly staff is always happy to recommend their favorites or provide information about the ingredients and history of each sweet. A visit to Indian Sweet Mart is a delightful experience that will leave you craving more.

I recently tried Sandesh (Sandhesh) sweet in Strawberry and Kacha Gola flavours, and it was absolutely amazing. The first thing that stunned me was that there are no preservatives—yet the freshness and texture were perfect.

Jagruti was prompt and cooperative, be it coordinating for the dispatch or suggesting the flavors.

Truly impressive quality. I’ll definitely be coming back for more!

Thank you!

Parina Mehta Shah

name: Sweet Bengal
description:
Indulge in the authentic flavors of Bengal right in the heart of Mumbai at Sweet Bengal, Nepean Sea Road. We bring you a delightful spread of traditional Bengali sweets crafted with love and age-old recipes. From the soft, syrupy Chum Chum to the irresistible Baked Rasogulla and the delicate, melt-in-your-mouth Sandesh, each bite is a celebration of Bengali heritage and sweetness.

Our sweets are made fresh daily using premium ingredients and time-honored techniques to ensure you experience the true essence of Bengal in every bite. Whether you're craving a nostalgic treat or looking to share a box of happiness with loved ones, Sweet Bengal is your go-to destination for all things sweet and soulful.

owner_posts.post_text: Indulge in the rich decadence of Kaju Pista Chocolate Ball at Sweet Bengal, home to famous Bengali sweets in Cumballa Hill, Mumbai. This exquisite treat combines the creamy smoothness of premium cashews with the nutty crunch of pistachios, all enveloped in luscious chocolate. Every bite offers a perfect balance of sweetness and texture, capturing the essence of artisanal Bengali confectionery. Ideal for gifting or a personal indulgence, these chocolate balls celebrate traditional flavors with a contemporary twist. Visit Sweet Bengal in Cumballa Hill to experience the finesse of hand-crafted Bengali sweets and let the Kaju Pista Chocolate Ball transport your taste buds into a world of rich, nutty delight.

Indulge in the tropical delight of Mango Mania at Sweet Bengal, a charming sweet shop near Nepean Sea Road, Cumballa Hill, Mumbai. These luscious mango-shaped treats are crafted from the finest mango pulp, offering a creamy, melt-in-your-mouth experience that captures the essence of summer in every bite. Perfectly sweet, richly textured, and visually delightful, Mango Mania is a celebration of India’s beloved king of fruits. Whether for gifting or personal indulgence, each piece promises authentic taste and artisanal quality. Visit this iconic sweet shop near Nepean Sea Road to savor the magic of mango in its most decadent form, and let Sweet Bengal elevate your festive and everyday moments with its signature creations.

Delight in the classic taste of Kheerkodom from Sweet Bengal, Cumballa Hill, Mumbai—a soft, melt-in-the-mouth Bengali sweet made with rich milk and traditional craftsmanship. Each bite offers a creamy texture and delicate sweetness that reflects the authentic flavors of Bengal’s heritage desserts. Prepared with premium ingredients and expert care, this timeless treat is perfect for festive celebrations or everyday indulgence.

If you are looking for a Bengali sweet shop near Cumballa Hill, Sweet Bengal stands out for its authentic recipes, freshness, and consistent quality. Experience the true essence of traditional Bengali sweets that bring comfort, nostalgia, and unforgettable taste in every serving.

Discover the exquisite range of premium dry fruits sweets from Sweet Bengal | Cumballa Hill, Mumbai, beautifully presented in an elegant festive gift box. Crafted with rich almonds, pistachios, and cashews, each piece reflects authentic taste, freshness, and traditional Indian मिठाई artistry. The vibrant assortment makes it perfect for gifting during celebrations, festivals, or special occasions, offering a luxurious blend of flavor and quality in every bite.

Renowned as the best sweet shop in South Mumbai, Sweet Bengal delivers unmatched authenticity and premium quality sweets that celebrate the true essence of Indian desserts. Whether for personal indulgence or thoughtful gifting, these dry fruit sweets bring joy, richness, and tradition together in one elegant collection.

Savor the authentic taste of Daab Payesh from Sweet Bengal in Cumballa Hill, Mumbai, a traditional Bengali dessert served in rustic clay pots for a truly nostalgic experience. This delicacy is crafted with creamy milk, tender coconut, and subtle sweetness that melts in your mouth, offering a refreshing and rich flavor profile in every spoonful. Known for its purity and premium ingredients, Sweet Bengal ensures every serving of Daab Payesh captures the essence of Kolkata’s iconic sweets while bringing it closer to Mumbai’s dessert lovers. Perfect for festive occasions or a luxurious treat after meals, this dessert stands out for its freshness, aroma, and authentic preparation. Visit Sweet Bengal in Cumballa Hill to experience this classic delicacy that beautifully blends tradition with taste, making it a must-try for anyone who loves premium Indian sweets and regional specialties.

featured_reviews.name: Meheck Mukherjee
featured_reviews.review_text:
I ordered Mer Konfekt products on Zomato

Gluten free Almond Cup Cakes - Description - says almond flour jaggery and belgian chocolate - No ingredients list on product - taste was good so reordered to realise
Brookie bars - Description - zero maida atop jowar cookie - no ingredient list on package says 100% whole wheat - no mention of jowar
Sprouted Moong Herb Chia Bread - Description says sprouted moong - ingredient list has white flour n jaggery
Buck Wheat Pizza base - description none - infredient list is clean - buckwheat flour pink salt olive oil apple cider vinegar water

So descrete ingredient lists are there - half declared descriptions misguiding customers -

kindly stop misguiding customers !

This was my last order to you unless you change your practices

featured_reviews.name: saumya poddar
featured_reviews.review_text: The breads here are advertised as healthy, but once I received the product and checked the ingredient list, it clearly mentioned white flour (maida). This is extremely disappointing and misleading. Customers who are consciously choosing healthier options trust such claims, and this kind of marketing breaks that trust. Selling products under the label of “healthy” while using refined flour feels dishonest. Brands and bakeries must be transparent about ingredients instead of misleading customers in the name of health.

featured_reviews.name: HARSHA PRAJAPATI
featured_reviews.review_text: I ordered two peanut butter cans from Zomato on 9th feb 2025 evening but one of the can was already opened, with black greasy paste around the tin and bottle neck area with manufacture date removed. I tried calling the shop multiple times but no one pick up and tried connecting with Zomato support team but they dismissed my concern as situational issue. This entire experience was disappointing. Please upgrade your food quality and service
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hi ma'am, 

We are really sorry about this- request you to please share with us your contact info on info@merkonfekt.com and our team will get in touch with you right away 

Thanks, 
Team Mer Konfekt
